items.definition:
the enlargement of an organ or tissue from the increase in size of its cells
Weightlifting can lead to muscle hypertrophy.

immoral or grossly unfair behavior
The judge spoke out against the iniquity of the system.

the condition of occurring in several different forms
In biology, polymorphism refers to the existence of multiple forms within a species.

a malignant tumor of connective or other nonepithelial tissue
The doctor diagnosed the patient with a rare form of sarcoma.

the act or process of moving something from one place to another
The translocation of the endangered species was carefully planned.

intellectuals or highly educated people
The city's intelligentsia gathered for the literary discussion.

the acceleration of a chemical reaction by a catalyst
Enzyme catalysis is crucial for many biological processes.

the art of investigating or discussing the truth of opinions
Plato's dialogues are a classic example of the dialectic method.

a powerful antioxidant found in plants, animals, fungi, and some bacteria and archaea
Glutathione plays a crucial role in protecting cells from damage.

a type of cytokine produced by white blood cells
Interleukin-6 plays a role in the body's immune response.

a small room or monument, cut in rock or built of stone, in which a dead person is laid or buried
The ancient king was laid to rest in a grand sepulchre.

a fortified camp of Ukrainian Cossacks
The Zaporozhian Sich was a semi-independent Cossack polity.

Any of a group of steroid hormones produced in the adrenal cortex or made synthetically.
The doctor prescribed a corticosteroid to reduce the inflammation.

The abnormal growth or development of cells, tissue, or organs.
The biopsy revealed signs of dysplasia.

Any disease of the brain that alters brain function or structure.
The patient was diagnosed with hepatic encephalopathy.

critical explanation or interpretation of a text, especially of scripture
His exegesis of the ancient text provided new insights.

a common mineral, lead sulfide, that is the principal ore of lead
Galena has a distinctive metallic luster.

a collection of preserved plant specimens, typically dried and mounted on sheets, with associated data, used for scientific study
The botanist spent hours in the herbarium.

a region of the forebrain below the thalamus that coordinates the autonomic nervous system and the activity of the pituitary, controlling body temperature, thirst, hunger, and other homeostatic systems, and involved in sleep and emotional activity
The hypothalamus plays a crucial role in regulating body temperature.

A salt in which the anion contains silicon and oxygen.
Quartz is a common silicate mineral.

a disease of the heart muscle
His diagnosis was dilated cardiomyopathy.

a sulfur-containing amino acid
Cysteine is one of the 20 standard amino acids.

the seminal fluid of male fish
The male salmon releases milt during spawning.

a wise and skillful lawgiver; a member of a legislative body
The ancient Greek solon introduced many reforms.

the state or process of being deprived of oxygen, which can result in unconsciousness or death
The cause of death was determined to be asphyxiation.

a class of psychoactive drugs
The doctor prescribed a benzodiazepine to help with anxiety.

machine (Latin, often in 'deus ex machina')
The sudden appearance of the hero felt like a deus ex machina.

a New Zealand tree or shrub of the myrtle family
The rata tree was covered in vibrant red flowers.

a male roe deer
A roebuck was spotted grazing in the field.

a traditional Okinawan weapon; an archaic term for a groom or attendant
The martial artist wielded two sais with precision.

a dry, winged fruit containing a single seed
Maple trees produce samara seeds that spin as they fall.

a woman who takes a dominant role in sadomasochistic sexual activity
The film explored the complex character of a dominatrix.

the action by the state or an authority of taking property from its owner for public use or benefit
The government announced the expropriation of land for the new highway.

a feudal tenant's or vassal's fidelity to a lord
The knights swore fealty to their king.

a cell in connective tissue that produces collagen and other fibers
Fibroblasts play a crucial role in wound healing.

the action of degrading someone to the status of a mere object
The essay discussed the objectification of women in media.

carbolic acid
Phenol is used in the production of plastics and disinfectants.

strong verbal or written attack
His essay was a fierce polemic against modern art.

antiparticle of the electron
A positron has the same mass as an electron but a positive charge.

an omen or sign
The sudden drop in temperature was a prognostic of a harsh winter.

a group of five
The quint of musicians performed a classical piece.

A person, especially an ambassador, invested with full power to transact business.
The plenipotentiary was authorized to sign the treaty.

cell division
Mitosis is a fundamental process for life, where a single cell divides into two identical daughter cells.

the practice of re-examining and reinterpreting historical events
The historian was accused of revisionism for his controversial new theory.

a drug used to treat retroviral infections, such as HIV
Antiretroviral drugs have significantly improved the lives of HIV patients.

a simple amino acid
Glycine is one of the simplest amino acids.

the study of the nervous system
She is pursuing a degree in neurobiology.

a compound of nitrogen with a more electropositive element
Silicon nitride is a ceramic material used in high-temperature applications.

a hormone and neurotransmitter
Norepinephrine plays a role in the body's 'fight or flight' response.

a structure that guides waves
Fiber optics use a type of waveguide to transmit light signals.

a neurotransmitter
Acetylcholine plays a key role in muscle contraction.

loss of ability to understand or express speech
After the stroke, he suffered from aphasia, making communication difficult.

a small rounded mass of a substance, especially of chewed food
The patient received a bolus of medication intravenously.

a fluid-filled sac that functions as a cushion between bones, tendons, and muscles
Inflammation of the bursa can cause pain in the shoulder.

the scientific study of the structure and properties of crystals
X-ray crystallography is crucial for determining molecular structures.

an abnormal connection between two body parts
The patient developed a fistula after the surgery.

the complete flower head of a plant including stems, stalks, bracts, and flowers
The sunflower has a large inflorescence.

an enzyme that removes phosphate groups
Alkaline phosphatase levels are often measured in blood tests.

a chain of amino acids linked by peptide bonds
Proteins are large polypeptides folded into specific three-dimensional structures.

a colorless gaseous hydrocarbon
Polypropylene is a plastic made from propylene monomers.

an administrative governor or guardian in some Muslim countries
The wali was responsible for the province's administration.

a modern pagan religion with roots in pre-Christian traditions
She is studying the history and practices of Wicca.

the proportion of the incident light or radiation that is reflected by a surface
The albedo of snow is very high, reflecting most sunlight.

the science of communications and automatic control systems in both machines and living things
Cybernetics explores the principles of control and communication in complex systems.
